property_summary: General rule: when setOwner(_owner) is called by the current owner, the contract's owner becomes the provided _owner (i.e., owner() == _owner); the mutant instead sets owner() == msg.sender breaking this for any call where _owner != msg.sender.
change_summary: Replace assignment owner = _owner; with owner = msg.sender; so setOwner sets owner to the caller rather than the provided address.
